subject: Request to pause demo — Cardea OKR reset
messages:
From: Hannah Liu <hannah.liu@cardea.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Perez <tom.perez@cardea.ai>
Date: Tue, Aug 4, 2026 at 11:22 AM PDT
Subject: Request to pause demo — Cardea OKR reset

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the walkthrough planning last week. I wanted to flag a change on our side: leadership ran a quick OKR reset today and the inference/LLM pilot has been pushed off the immediate roadmap. We need to pause scheduled customer-facing work while we re-evaluate priorities and headcount allocation.

Specifically: can we park the hands-on demo scheduled for next Tuesday? Our PMs (Tom is cc'd) have been reallocated to a platform stability sprint and won't be available to participate in the pilot for the next 6–8 weeks. We still want to evaluate Redwood — this is a timing issue, not a no — and I'd prefer to regroup once we have bandwidth rather than doing a rushed or incomplete pilot.

Please keep any materials you have shared (deck, SOW draft) in the HubSpot/Drive record and I'll reach back out when we have clarity. If there's anything you need from me to make the pause easier (e.g., a short note for our procurement team explaining the timing), let me know.

Appreciate your flexibility.

—
Hannah Liu
Head of Data & ML
Cardea AI
hannah.liu@cardea.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Liu <hannah.liu@cardea.ai>
Cc: Tom Perez <tom.perez@cardea.ai>
Date: Wed, Aug 5, 2026 at 10:03 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Request to pause demo — Cardea OKR reset

Hi Hannah — thanks for the heads up and totally understand.

We can absolutely pause the scheduled demo — I will remove the calendar hold and mark the HubSpot deal as "on hold / timing" so it doesn't show as active in your pipeline. A couple quick notes so we have clear next steps:

- I'll upload the latest Redwood-Deck-v2.pdf and the SOW-term-sheet.docx to the Drive and link them on the HubSpot deal.
- If it's useful, I can send a 12–15 minute recorded walkthrough of the core inference flow (no setup required on your side) so your PMs can scan later when they have time.
- Let's tentatively target the week of Oct 5 for a reconnect (about 8 weeks). If your team thinks 6 weeks is better, say the word and we'll pencil that in instead.

Would you prefer I set a tentative 20-minute check-in on Oct 5 and we'll cancel if not needed, or should I wait for you to open the follow-up when you have bandwidth?

Attaching: Redwood-Deck-v2.pdf, SOW-term-sheet.docx (attached for your records).

Thanks again for the transparency — appreciate it.

Best,

Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0134

[Attachment: Redwood-Deck-v2.pdf]
[Attachment: SOW-term-sheet.docx]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Aug 6, 2026 at 2:12 PM PDT
Subject: Cardea AI — demo parked (OKR reset) — action items

Ben / Marissa,

Looping you in — Cardea (DEAL-5892) asked to pause their hands-on inference demo due to an internal OKR reset. Hannah (cc'd earlier) confirmed the team won't have bandwidth for ~6–8 weeks. Tom Perez is their engineering lead.

Please action the following:
- Marissa: update the HubSpot stage to "On Hold - timing" and add a task reminder for 2026-10-05 to prompt a follow-up. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5892
- Ben: note in the pipeline that this is a timing pause, not a product concern. No discount or escalation needed at this time.
- Marissa: upload the latest deck and SOW to the Cardea Drive folder (I've attached them in my reply) and set a permission for Hannah and Tom. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-Redwood-Deck-v2

If we want to keep engagement light, I suggested sending a short recorded walkthrough that Hannah can share internally. I'll queue that up if you both are OK.

Thanks — I'll leave the tentative follow-up window open but won't block capacity on our side.

—
Sofia

Sofia — thanks, that plan works for us.

Please go ahead and send the short recorded walkthrough; I will share it with Tom and the PMs so they can get a quick sense while they're tied up. Let's tentatively aim for the week of Oct 5 for a reconnect — I'll ping you sooner if the sprint reprioritization finishes earlier.

I'll also add a note on our side to re-open conversation if procurement signs off or we get headcount earlier than expected. Appreciate you keeping the HubSpot record and Drive files current.

See you in October (tentatively) — and feel free to reach out if you need anything in the interim.
